summary: Challenge to blacklisting and show cause notice; prior quashing of blacklisting order does not bar fresh proceedings; inquiry not precluded by earlier writ judgment; fresh show cause notice sustainable; allegations on paper lifting and bank guarantee suppression require response; authorities must consider explanation before action; precedent cited from UP v. Brahm Datt Sharma and Secretary, MoD v. Prabhash Chandra Mirdha; reappreciation disallowed at this stage.
legal_provisions_cited: STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH V. BRAHM DATT SHARMA & ANR. (1987) 2 SCC 179
SECRETARY, MINISTRY OF DEFENCE & ORS. V. PRABHASH CHANDRA MIRDHA (2012) 11 SCC 565
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment dismissing writ appeal set aside; matter remanded for consideration of explanation to fresh show cause notice.
